flow_summary: The interviewer successfully navigated a challenging, confused patient persona by consistently breaking down complex questions and patiently re-explaining scales. issues.evidence: The interviewer had to repeat the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 scales multiple times because the patient kept losing the thread, which, while necessary for this persona, made the interaction feel somewhat mechanical.
